name: The Weaving
premise: Sleep takes you; your believers hang in the dark as points of your color.
loop: With your last stamina you draw a thread from believer to believer with slow movements. The thread holds only while your pace stays gentle and your turns stay wide; a rushed segment frays and snaps. Longer chains reach further and are harder to hold.
signals: The thread is drawn light between bodies; fraying shows as the thread thinning and trembling; a completed chain settles into a steady channel glow.
outcome_win: Completed chains carry belief between the sleepers all generation.
outcome_fail: A snapped thread leaves its two ends dark; unchained believers stand alone against the grey.
why_fun: The ambition tradeoff — every extra link is reach you want and risk you must hold with smoother hands.
gdd_quote: Completed chains become channels belief travels while you are gone
